thesis: PDD enters the 5/27 Q1 print as a coin-flip on direction with rich, crush-prone vol: 5/29 weekly IV 98.3% vs ~42% back-month [STRUCT:iv_term_structure], VRP +0.072 [HIST:vrp]. Genuine DP block buying (100% buy, $17.09M [DP:block_stratified]) is offset by a fundamental VETO (EPS -13.2% TTM, China retail +0.2% [FUND:epsGrowthTTMYoy, MACRO:ChinaRetail_2026-04]) and a debate that disconfirmed both directions (0.55/0.55 [DEBATE:bull_residual]). Only surviving edge: sell the overpriced event move with defined risk, put-skewed for the -$8.63M short-gamma accelerant at 95 [STRUCT:gex]. Directional exposure is watch-only.
